release_notes: Prerelease from https://github.com/mwongj/VOD2MLIB/pull/2 (source PR remains open). Fixes the settings form: all reconciliation fields are appended after existing settings under [MEDIA LIBRARY & CLEANUP], followed by a short section description. Adds help text for all 12 new fields, including TV handling, server-check failure, duplicate cleanup, M3U removals and timing, and deletion scope. Explains option behavior and what files are preserved. Runtime and manifest definitions agree. Retains rc.1 reconciliation behavior, native Dispatcharr category selection, 1,000-record SQLite bulk writes, raw URL comparisons for STRMs, and hashes for optional unedited NFO cleanup. Validation: 272 local tests passed with one Windows symlink test skipped; Python 3.10/3.12 Linux CI, package/import and publisher checks passed.
